relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that LOS stimulates Bdk generation via interaction with TLR4.

relationships.subject: Vag8
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that Vag8 exacerbates the cough response of mice by upregulating the Bdk level through the inhibition of C1-Inh activity.

relationships.subject: Bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Bdk sensitizes TRPV1, which is regulated by the phosphorylation states mediated by both PKC and PKA

relationships.subject: B2 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Mice preadministered antagonists against the B2 receptor (B2R) and TRPV1 exhibited reduced levels of coughing in response to bacterial lysate

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1-deficient mice, but not TRPA1-deficient mice, were less responsive to the combination of LOS, PTx, and Vag8 (Fig. 4B)

relationships.subject: pertussis toxin
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that PTx exacerbates Bdk-induced sensitization of TRPV1 through an increase in intracellular cAMP levels, followed by PKA-mediated phosphorylation of TRPV1.

key_findings: LOS (via TLR4), Vag8 (via C1-Inh inhibition) and PTx cooperatively cause pertussis cough in mice through a bradykinin-B2R-TRPV1 pathway.
PTx removes Gi-mediated inhibition and exacerbates bradykinin-induced TRPV1 sensitization in HEK293T cells and DRG neurons.
